channel.title: Jiǎoluò Shūwū · 角落書屋
channel.description: A reading nook for Chinese language and civilisation. Characters, vocabulary, grammar, history, philosophy, and the world they shaped.

item.title: 定 · to fix, settle, decide, surely
item.description: A settling element coming to rest under a roof. From that image of a thing made still and fixed in place grows the whole field of 定: to decide, to set, the fixed and stable, the certain and sure.

item.title: 而 · and, but, yet (a classical connective)
item.description: A pictograph of a beard, borrowed early as one of the busiest function words in literary Chinese. 而 links clause to clause as and, but, or yet, ties manner to verb, and frames set phrases like 而且 and 而已.

item.title: 画 · to draw, a painting, a stroke
item.description: A hand with a brush drawing the boundaries of a field. From that image grows the whole world of pictures: to paint, a painting, and the single stroke of a character.

item.title: 节 · joint, node, festival, to economize
item.description: A bamboo joint, the segment between the knots. From that node grows everything that comes in sections: the joint of a limb, the chapter of a book, the festival that knots the calendar, and the restraint that keeps a thing within bounds.

item.title: 声 · sound, voice, tone, reputation
item.description: A chime-stone struck before a listening ear. From that image grow the everyday word for sound and voice, the tone of speech, and the wider sense of making something known: a declaration, a reputation, a name.

item.title: 本 · root, origin, this, a book
item.description: A tree with its root marked: the character for where a thing comes from. From root grows origin, the fundamental, one's own, the principal sum, and the bound volume you hold in your hand.

item.title: 部 · part, section, ministry, measure word
item.description: The right-side city-mound radical marks an administrative division. From that grows the whole family of parts and wholes: a section of something, a government ministry, a military unit, and the measure word counted out for films, machines, and phones.

item.title: 菜 · vegetable, dish, cuisine
item.description: Plants gathered to be eaten. From the picked greens grows a whole table: the vegetable, the cooked dish, the regional cuisine, and the slangy put-down for anyone weak at a task.

item.title: 常 · constant, ordinary, often
item.description: A long banner of cloth that came to mean what endures: the constant and the lasting, the ordinary and the common, and the things that happen again and again.

item.title: 成 · to become, succeed, accomplished
item.description: A halberd standing guard over a finished task. From that image grows the whole field of completion: to become, to succeed, to accomplish, the ready-made and the mature, and even the colloquial yes that settles a matter.

item.title: 词 · word, term, diction, the sung lyric
item.description: Speech beside a phonetic 司: the unit we call a word, the wording a speaker chooses, and the classical lyric form that grew up beside regulated verse to be sung to set tune-patterns.

item.title: 第 · the ordinal prefix, rank, mansion
item.description: Bamboo over younger-brother, an image of things laid out in sequence. From it grows the prefix that turns a count into an order, plus the older senses of examination rank and grand residence.

item.title: 点 · dot, point, a little, o'clock
item.description: From a single dot of ink the character spreads into points and decimals, into the hours of the clock, into ordering food and lighting a flame, and into the small quantity that softens a sentence.

item.title: 动 · to move, to act, to stir
item.description: Force applied to a thing sets it in motion. From that one idea grow the words for sport and activity, for the stirred heart, for the drive that pushes a machine or a life forward, and for the verb itself.

item.title: 法 · law, method, the Dharma
item.description: Water against the level mark. From that image of fair, flowing measure grows the whole field of 法: the law and the court, the method and the way of doing a thing, and the Buddhist Dharma itself.

item.title: 方 · square, direction, method
item.description: One glyph that runs from the literal square to the cardinal directions, to the place a thing sits, to the method by which it is done. The geometry of orientation and approach.

item.title: 非 · not, wrong, un-
item.description: Two wings spreading in opposite directions: from that image of opposition grows the great negator. Not and non-, the line between right and wrong, and the un- prefix that turns a word against itself.

item.title: 分 · to divide, minute, point, cent
item.description: A knife splitting a thing in two. From the cut grows everything that comes in parts: the minute on the clock, the point on a test, the cent in your pocket, and the act of separating itself.

item.title: 个 · the universal measure word, individual
item.description: The general-purpose measure word that counts almost anything, and the root of individual. From the bamboo-stalk tally grew the everyday classifier 一个 and the words for individual, personality, and build.

item.title: 汉 · the Han river, dynasty, people, and a man
item.description: A river that named a dynasty, and a dynasty that named a people. From the water of 汉水 grew 汉族 the Han ethnicity, 汉语 and 汉字 the Chinese language and script, and 好汉, the brave fellow.

item.title: 候 · to wait, time, season, climate
item.description: A person standing watch beside the road. From the figure of one who waits and watches grows the everyday word for when (时候), the act of awaiting (等候), and the long rhythm of the weather (气候).

item.title: 花 · flower, to spend, patterned
item.description: A plant caught in its transformed, blooming state: the flower, the act of spending money or time, and the patterned, fancy, or blurred. One glyph that runs from the garden to the wallet to the dazzled eye.

item.title: 话 · words, speech, talk, language
item.description: Speech beside a tongue: the everyday character for spoken words. From it grow talking and conversation, the telephone, a dialect or standard language, and the topics and sayings people pass around.

item.title: 欢 · joy, merry, to be pleased
item.description: A breath of open delight: the hand and the open mouth that make laughter. From this glyph come joy and merriment, to like and to welcome, and the lively, high-spirited mood.

item.title: 回 · to return, to turn back, a time
item.description: Two squares nested like a coiling eddy. The character for coming back: returning home, turning around, replying, and counting the times a thing happens.

item.title: 记 · to remember, to record, a mark
item.description: Speech set beside the self: the act of fixing something so it will not be lost. From that image grow three senses: to remember, to write down, and the mark left behind.

item.title: 间 · space between, interval, room
item.description: Sunlight in the crack between two doors: the character for the space between things. From that gap grow time, the middle ground, the human world, and the room you count one by one.

item.title: 教 · to teach, teaching, religion
item.description: A hand with a rod beside a child at the lesson. From that scene of instruction grows a wide field: to teach and educate, to teach a skill in the spoken jiao reading, and the teaching that became the word for religion.

item.title: 进 · to enter, to advance, to take in
item.description: A foot on the road and a bird that only ever walks forward. From that image grows everything that moves ahead and moves in: to enter, to advance, to progress, to carry out, and to take goods in.

item.title: 经 · classic, scripture, to pass through, warp threads
item.description: The lengthwise warp threads strung on a loom, the structural through-lines that hold a fabric together. From that image grow the canonical classic, the act of passing through, and the running of an enterprise.
